sources.title: Bresciani–Vistoli, Fields of moduli and the arithmetic of tame quotient singularities
inspected_locators: section5.1, Definition5.3 and universal-family diagram, manuscript pp10–11
sources.relationship_to_claim: Earlier general framework implies the universal bound through the fully stated split-target bridge.
sources.version_note: Dated v1 used; published DOI10.1112/S0010437X2400705X confirmed separately. Guessed published-PDF path failed; no publisher-PDF hash invented.

sources.title: Bresciani, The field of moduli of a divisor on a rational curve
sources.relationship_to_claim: Earlier general genus-zero-gerbe proposition implies split compression for noncyclic E, hence V4 degree1.
sources.version_note: ArXiv page lists onlyv1; attemptedv3 returned404.

sources.title: Bresciani, The field of moduli of a divisor on a rational curve, J.Algebra647(2024),72–98
sources.relationship_to_claim: Published confirmation of the general proposition; divisor-summary statements alone are not substituted for the split-target derivation.
sources.version_note: Published PDF obtained from author institutional repository; different numbering/expanded exposition fromarXivv1.

sources.title: Bresciani, The field of moduli of varieties with a structure, first preprint
inspected_locators: proofs of twisted quotient and normalizer criterion
sources.relationship_to_claim: Earlier formalization applies to faithful coarse structures, not actual marked-cover gerbes.
sources.version_note: Independently retrieved and compared withv2/published version.

sources.title: Bresciani, The field of moduli of varieties with a structure, revised preprint
sources.relationship_to_claim: Explicitly identifies all relevant twisted quotients; confirms the generality of the compression argument.
sources.version_note: Do not confuse H1(N)->H1(N/E) surjectivity with vanishing of the PGL2class.

sources.title: Bresciani, The field of moduli of varieties with a structure, Boll.UnioneMat.Ital.17(2024),613–624
sources.relationship_to_claim: Published confirmation of the faithful-structure and twisted-quotient formalism.
sources.version_note: Publisher PDF directly retrieved and hashed.

sources.title: Huggins, Fields of moduli of hyperelliptic curves
sources.relationship_to_claim: Earlier related hyperelliptic theorem and theV4/S3 compression mechanism, not directly asserted as all inner-markedHurwitz theorem.
sources.version_note: Downloadedv1 and current PDF were byteidentical. Published MRL14(2007),249–262, DOI10.4310/MRL.2007.v14.n2.a8.

sources.title: Beauville, Finite subgroups of PGL(2,K)
sources.relationship_to_claim: Classical subgroup/cohomology mechanism; rational-subgroup classification is not silently generalized to nonconstant forms.
sources.version_note: ArXiv record2009; PDF has internal date2018, so no date inferred from PDF alone.

sources.title: Doyle–Silverman, A uniform field-of-definition/field-of-moduli bound for dynamical systems on PN
sources.relationship_to_claim: N1 bound credits Hidalgo; higher-dimensional endomorphism theorem is neighboring rather than an identical marked-cover result.

sources.title: Hidalgo, On the FOD/FOM parameter of rational maps
sources.relationship_to_claim: General rational-map-action quadratic theorem and branch-signature method corroborate older mechanism; full Hurwitz input not equated with rational maps.
sources.version_note: Retrieved current PDF; not used to assign the oldest sufficient prior date.

sources.title: Lercier–Ritzenthaler–Sijsling, Fast computation of isomorphisms of hyperelliptic curves and explicit Galois descent
sources.relationship_to_claim: Explicitly corrects the purported cubicV4 obstruction and descends the genus5family toQ.
sources.version_note: Published PDF independently downloaded; original audit had timed out, so this audit improves the source evidence. DOI10.2140/obs.2013.1.463.

sources.title: Hidalgo, On p-gonal fields of definition, older manuscript
sources.relationship_to_claim: Different field-of-definition versus hyperelliptic-form issue; not the general marked-cover coarse question.
sources.version_note: Withdrawal/update context is not used to discredit or support the central result.

sources.title: Hidalgo, On p-gonal fields of definition, revised manuscript
sources.relationship_to_claim: Neighboring conditional p-gonal coordinate descent; hypotheses start from a field of definition, not arbitrary reduced coarseHurwitzpoint.
sources.version_note: No direct substitution for the target theorem.

sources.title: Cadoret, Lifting results for rational points on Hurwitz moduli spaces
sources.relationship_to_claim: Source framework and actual degree2 lower bounds; nonoptimal upper bounds and stated uncertainty do not prove universal2.
